_contract.what: Ava's OWN run-event vocabulary — the four kinds `AgentRuntime.iter_run` yields and the chat client folds into the transcript.
_contract.why: This vocabulary is spelled twice, in two languages, in files that never import each other: ava_bridge/runtime/base.py (and each adapter's iter_run) emits it, frontend/src/lib/chatEvents.ts consumes it. Python proved the emit, vitest proved the parse, and NOTHING proved they agree — so a fifth kind, a renamed field, or a dropped one would pass both suites and break a live turn.
_contract.how: Both sides are tested against THIS file. tests/test_run_event_vocabulary.py holds the Python emitter to it; frontend/src/lib/chatEvents.contract.test.ts folds every sample through the real reducer. Changing the vocabulary means changing this file, which fails both suites until both sides follow.
_contract.note: These are AVA's kinds, not the gateway's. The gateway's own wire vocabulary is captured separately in gateway-schemas.json — translating one into the other is exactly what the runtime adapter exists to do.
